skill.name: OpenAI Agents Python SDK Installation and Verification
skill.description: Install and configure the OpenAI Agents SDK for Python to enable agent development and monitoring. Use when starting a new Python-based agent project that requires OpenAI integration.
skill.skill_body:
Install the openai-agents package via pip. Verify installation by importing the package in your Python environment. Consult the Python integration guide and OpenAI Agents Python documentation for framework-specific configuration steps.

## Objective

establish_openai_agents_environment
## Applicable Signals

- Project requires OpenAI agent framework
- Python environment is available
- No prior OpenAI Agents installation detected

## Contraindications

- Using TypeScript or non-OpenAI agent frameworks
- Environment already configured with openai-agents
- Project uses alternative LLM providers exclusively

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'action': 'Run pip install command', 'detail': 'Execute: pip install openai-agents'}
- {'step': 2, 'action': 'Verify installation', 'detail': 'Import openai_agents in Python REPL or test script to confirm successful installation'}
- {'step': 3, 'action': 'Review integration documentation', 'detail': 'Consult Python integration guide and OpenAI Agents Python documentation for framework-specific setup'}

## Constraints

- Python environment must be available
- pip package manager must be accessible
- Internet connectivity required for package download

## Output Contract

- openai-agents package installed and importable
- Python environment ready for agent development
- Caller can proceed to agent code development
